messages:
Priya: Can we run a quick smoke + cost scan for marlin-7b-quant on Dedicated? Need p95 and tokens/s for chat short-turn (32 tokens) and long-turn (512). Also want mem peak and a rough $/token estimate.

Evan: Yep, I can queue that. Running on ded-gpu-a (A100) and ded-gpu-b (H100) variants. ETA ~40m.

InfraBot: Job 45123 queued -> running on ded-gpu-a. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/45123 :computer:

Sam: Quick ask — include KV-cache warmup (10 prefix tokens) and test batch sizes 1 and 8. Capture mem_peak, kernel time breakdown, and RNG seed for repro.

Maria: Adding prompt sets 'chat-short' and 'doc-long' to the job. Perf tracing enabled.

InfraBot: Job 45123 completed. Results uploaded: https://ci.redwood/results/45123 :file_folder:

Evan: Summary (ded-gpu-a / A100) -- chat-short: p50=18ms p95=48ms tokens/s=320 mem_peak=14.6GB cost_est=$0.0009/token; long-turn: p50=22ms p95=92ms tokens/s=290.

Evan: Summary (ded-gpu-b / H100) -- chat-short: p50=14ms p95=36ms tokens/s=420 mem_peak=13.2GB cost_est=$0.0007/token; long-turn: p50=19ms p95=78ms tokens/s=380.

Priya: Nice. Any decoding issues or detokenization glitches on the samples?

Sam: Output quality looked fine on the 50-sample smoke set. Noted a small 99th percentile tail on H100 when batch=8 (about 1 in 500 requests) — attached stderr logs show occasional kernel stall around step 57.

Lee: Did we try the int8 quant profile in this run? Curious about memory savings and perf regression.

Evan: Not in 45123. I can queue a focused int8 pass on ded-gpu-b tomorrow; rough expectation: mem ~ -18% and tokens/s -5% but we'll validate.

Priya: OK please run int8 on H100-only and post a delta table (A100 vs H100 vs H100-int8). If the tail persists on H100-int8, consider enabling soft-fallback to marlin-7b-std for p95-sensitive routes.

InfraBot: Follow-up job 45124 queued (int8-run) -> scheduled start in 12h.

Maria: Thanks — I've updated the onboarding doc with the perf numbers, raw traces, and action items. I'll also draft a short canary rollout plan for traffic routing rules (p95 budget + fallback).

Priya: Great. Follow-ups assigned: @Evan run int8 and post delta table, @Sam investigate tail logs and link repro, @Maria prepare canary rollout note. We'll reconvene after int8 results. :thumbsup:
